title: Tech Note: The new EDIT FORMULA dialog in 4D 2004
featured_technology: 4D formulas (QUERY BY FORMULA / ORDER BY FORMULA style expressions)

historical_commentary.text: Based on the available teaser text, this note covers the redesigned EDIT FORMULA dialog introduced in 4D 2004 and how to use formulas within a 4D database (e.g., for formula-based queries and calculations). Formulas remain a core 4D language concept today, but the specific dialog UI shown has been redesigned multiple times since 2005, and Project Mode's text-based method/formula editors (introduced 2018) represent a substantially different editing experience than the Design Mode dialog this note documents, so the specific UI walkthrough is dated even though the underlying formula concept endures.
related_updates: 4D's formula/method editing interface has been redesigned multiple times since 2004, including the shift to Project Mode's text-based editors starting with 4D v17 (2018)
Formula-based querying and calculation remain a core, actively used part of the current 4D language
